perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Q2 evidence still shows exceptional incretin-led growth, while the Sept. 18 Inluriyo-Verzenio FDA approval adds realized oncology execution.

A materially different Sept. 11 primary source confirms completion of the AtaiBeckley acquisition, adding BPL-003 and rapid-acting neuroplastogen optionality in treatment-resistant depression rather than merely an announced transaction.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Completed acquisition and FDA approval are realized corporate/regulatory execution, but neither establishes commercial uptake or economic contribution.
Strong incretin volume/revenue momentum continues to coexist with realized-price compression; pipeline diversification may reduce concentration over time but does not erase pricing risk.

contradictions: Strong volume/revenue momentum coexists with realized-price compression.
